[1/3] Plan centroid group rotate and uniform scale for multi-selection

impact_assessment.why: Multi-selection only translated; rotating or scaling several nodes around a shared center required per-node edits.
impact_assessment.benefits: A pivot rotation or uniform scale preview and one transform_selection action with undo for top-level selected nodes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 27; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock; state: parent-relative local decomposition, non-uniform parent scales, selected descendant deduplication.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Filter top-level selected roots, compose parent-world rotation, convert world positions through the parent inverse, preview with pivot matrices, and add rotation/scale/undo tests.

[1/3] Plan viewport box selection with replace/add/toggle modifiers and existing selection/gizmo integration

impact_assessment.why: The viewport can only click-select one node at a time; Unity/Unreal-style multi-selection needs marquee selection over projected bounds.
impact_assessment.benefits: A box-select mode draws a rectangle and selects intersecting nodes with replace/add/toggle modifiers, reusing select_many, highlighting and the batch centroid gizmo.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST change, UI-only; dependency: none; concurrency: pointer arbitration with camera orbit, gizmo drags and pointer capture; state: projected AABB edge cases and overlay cleanup.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add explicit box-select mode, prioritize gizmo hits, project all eight bounds corners, cancel cleanly on pointercancel, and add static UI/viewer regression checks.

[1/3] Plan multi-node shared property/transform editing and shared/mixed selection summary

impact_assessment.why: The inspector edits only the primary node; multi-selection cannot batch-edit name, visibility, tags, layer or absolute transforms.
impact_assessment.benefits: set_selection_properties/set_selection_transform edit the ordered selection in one undo, /api/editor exposes shared vs mixed fields, and the console routes inspector apply buttons to the batch actions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 28 and two new actions; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: mixed values, root/empty selection, parent/child transform semantics, undo.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate all selected nodes through existing single-node validators, apply under one history entry, expose shared/mixed summaries, and add property/transform/undo tests.

[1/3] Plan axis-local group scaling around the selection centroid

impact_assessment.why: Multi-selection scale is uniform; X/Y/Z handles must scale only their own world axis around the centroid.
impact_assessment.benefits: Group scale accepts X/Y/Z factors, previews the selected axis in the viewport, commits one transform_selection action and remains undoable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 29 and group_scale shape extension; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: scalar compatibility, positive factor validation, rotated-node approximation and parent inverse conversion.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Accept scalar or three-factor group_scale, apply world-axis offsets with local scale factors, update the gizmo preview/callback, and add axis scaling and undo tests.

[1/3] Plan scene-group save-as with source camera/environment and container-transform persistence

impact_assessment.why: Scene groups save with current editor settings, ignore container placement and cannot be saved under a new name.
impact_assessment.benefits: Groups retain source camera/environment and container transforms, save-as updates metadata with undo, and both survive whole-scene/group reloads.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: scene snapshot schema 5 and editor schema 30; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: optional metadata docs, save file before metadata update, overwrite/rename semantics and legacy groups.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Persist source docs in SceneGroup, load settings through scene_from_dict, write container transform as the saved root, update name under history, and add source/save-as/transform tests.

[1/3] Plan box-selection proxies for meshless/hidden nodes and near-plane-safe AABB clipping

impact_assessment.why: Box selection ignores hidden and meshless nodes and drops bounds whose corners cross the camera plane.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every scene node contributes a selectable projected AABB or world-position proxy, and marquee hits remain correct when bounds straddle the near plane.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI-only, no REST/schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: pointer arbitration unchanged; state: proxy false positives, camera-inside-AABB, clipped projection math and root exclusion.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep click-pick bounds visible-only, add separate box bounds/proxies, clip AABB faces against the near plane, handle camera-inside bounds, and add static regression checks.
